node: Commercial kitchen, beverage, refrigeration, and equipment service networks
summary: Layer 1B expansion found a small set of US-listed names with plausible exposure to restaurant kitchen uptime, beverage systems, refrigeration, MRO, and equipment service. The cleanest direct reference names are Middleby and ITW Food Equipment. The underfollowed lane is thinner: Farmer Bros. is a micro-cap speculative exception with unusually direct coffee/beverage distribution plus equipment-servicing exposure to foodservice customers, while DXP Enterprises is a broader MRO/service-network hypothesis with food-and-beverage industrial exposure but weaker direct restaurant-chain evidence. No buy/sell view is implied.
